meta.note: Jobs within reach: all jobs in Colorado (LEHD LODES JT00, primary and secondary). Jobs across the state line are not counted. Where residents work: primary jobs only (JT01, one per worker), with residents who work in another state in the total. Drive times assume no traffic. A town's own jobs always count. Counties: population-weighted average of their towns and Census communities.

sources.flows_other_states: LODES8 <state>/od/<state>_od_aux_JT01_2023.csv.gz for: al, ar, az, ca, ct, dc, de, fl, ga, hi, ia, id, il, in, ks, ky, la, ma, md, me, mn, mo, ms, mt, nc, nd, ne, nh, nj, nm, nv, ny, oh, ok, or, pa, ri, sc, sd, tn, tx, ut, va, vt, wa, wi, wv, wy
sources.routing: OSRM on OpenStreetMap roads (router.project-osrm.org), free-flow drive times
